topic: Force as a Vector and Free-Body Diagrams
key_concepts: Force is a vector quantity with magnitude and direction
Arrow length indicates force strength or magnitude
Vectors can be drawn to scale on graphing paper
A vector can be resolved into horizontal and vertical components
x-components lie along East-West and y-components along North-South
Balanced forces occur when an object is at rest or moving at constant velocity
Unbalanced forces produce a net force and change motion
